meta.parties: Executor of Last Will of Rambukwella Siddhartha v. Sumana Thero

rules.statement: A testamentary disposition is not an alienation but only a wish or desire as to the manner in which the property should devolve after death, and does not vest title during the testator's lifetime.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is a distinction between a testamentary disposition-always ambulatory and revocable-and an alienation inter vivos. A testamentary disposition is not an alienation but only a wish or a desire as to the manner in which the property should devolve after death."
